# 1 Enoch Chapter 107 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Birth of Noah (Appendix)

---

**107:1** After-that-I-explained-to-him all-the-secrets-of-the-book-of-Enoch-and-all-the-parables which-had-been-given-to-me-in-them-and-summed-them-up-for-him.

**107:2** And-he-departed-to-him and-called-the-name-of-that-son-Noah; for-he-will-comfort-the-earth-after-all-the-destruction.

**107:3** A-different-son-was-born-to-him-after-the-flood-who-was-called-Nir, and-all-the-secrets-of-his-mystery-were-shown-to-Noah-concerning-the-destruction-which-was-approaching-during-the-generation-which-Nir-and-his-son-were-to-rule-over.

---

*EMET notes: Ch. 107 is a brief transitional chapter closing the Noah birth narrative. V. 1: Enoch shares with Methuselah the content of the Enochic books — this is the transmission of revelation across generations. V. 2 provides the name etymology: Noah (nuah) = "he will comfort/give rest to the earth." V. 3 introduces Nir, a figure who appears in the Slavonic text (2 Enoch) as a messianic high-priestly figure; this verse may be a later insertion or may reflect a richer original tradition.*
